overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole met with the City Assessor to evaluate the potential implementation of a residential property tax exemption. The committee reviewed financial impact projections and logistical staffing requirements before requesting further data for future consideration.

items.title: Discussion of Residential Property Tax Exemption Implementation (Resolution 26-066)
items.summary: City Assessor Jared Yagjian presented a data analysis showing an estimated $1.15 million break-even point and projected that over 90% of eligible single-family homeowners would see tax reductions, though the tax burden would shift to high-value apartment complexes and non-resident owners. The committee kept the matter in committee and requested that the assessor provide the underlying spreadsheets and more granular data regarding seniors and property trusts.
